release_notes:
Show your eBay seller feedback on the homepage

Manage Testimonial now lets you show your eBay seller feedback on the homepage instead of (or alongside a toggle with) your client testimonials. Enter your eBay seller user id and choose the source; your public eBay feedback — positive, neutral and negative — is fetched, cached for 7 days, and shown in a slowly auto-rolling carousel with the eBay logo linking to your profile.
